verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Workable using AI to write job descriptions, outreach sequences or rejection notes, in the recruiter's tone or otherwise. The AI evidence covers candidate sourcing, recommendations and screening (the Workable Agent). Translating job posts into nine languages is an adjacent feature, not AI drafting from the role's context.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
